messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling out model-variant v2 to 10% of inference traffic in eu-west-1. Automated health checks enabled.

sana: seeing elevated mem usage on a few GPU hosts, not yet in alerts. spikes around 1:02am UTC.

mike: getting a P0 page from pagerduty: `Inference Cluster - Pod OOMs` — assigning to oncall. @mike oncall responding.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1134 - pod_ooms_inference_eu_west (severity: high). Pager: mike.

mike: jumping in. Sana — can you paste the pod logs + top? suspecting mem leak from v2.

sana: logs (snip):
```
2026-03-17T01:02:13Z model_server[v2]: KV cache rehydration started
2026-03-17T01:02:14Z model_server[v2]: alloc 3.2Gi -> 6.8Gi in 30s
2026-03-17T01:02:45Z model_server[v2]: oom-killer invoked, process killed
```
Top shows GPU memory creeping and OOMs across 3 hosts.

jonah: our autorevert rule is based on 5xx rate > 3% for 5m, not memory. that explains why automated rollback did not trigger.

owen: starting traffic siphon to fallback model v1 and toggling rollout flag off. Command: `ffctl set rollout_v2 false --env prod --region eu-west-1`

sana: flag flip accepted. traffic to v2 dropping from 10% -> 0% in backend logs. Some pods still in crash loop because OOMed.

mike: initiating manual rollback per runbook. Steps: 1) disable rollout flag (done), 2) scale down v2 deployment to 0 replicas: `kubectl scale deploy model-v2 --replicas=0 -n inference-eu-west-1`, 3) drain evicted pods, 4) monitor SLOs.

jonah: mike ran the scale command, pods terminating. I'm watching the metrics dashboard: error rate falling, 95th latency trending back to baseline.

cs-bot: Customer Impact: 12 customer requests returned 5xx between 01:02-01:06 UTC; no billing anomalies reported. Notifying CS.

mike: can ops-sre follow up to collect heap dumps from one v2 instance for triage? we need a postmortem item to update autorevert signals.

owen: ops-sre pinged. runbook snippet added to thread: `collect-heap --pod model-v2-xyz --out /tmp/heap-v2-xyz.hprof`

sana: verified all v2 pods scaled down and new deploys not picking v2. memory pressure cleared on nodes.

mike: marking incident as mitigated; keeping channel open for verification for 30m. Action items: (1) add memory-based autorevert metric, (2) add test harness for v2 to simulate long sequences, (3) postmortem.

pagerduty-bot: Incident updated: status -> mitigated. Incident duration: ~15m.

jonah: quick note: we should also consider adding a fallback routing rule in the smart-router to avoid full 10% rollout for model variants until perf smoke tests pass.

mike: agreed. Filing follow-up tickets. thanks all :thumbsup:
